# Server deployment state
# Generated by Codebuff after verifying the live site matches this worktree.
#
# The live checkout on the server (~/public_html, a git checkout of origin/main)
# and the live site at https://usydastro.org/ both stand at:
LIVE_SERVER_GIT_REV=15e3b2a
#
# This file's own commit is bookkeeping on top of that rev, so it is one commit
# ahead of what it records; the authoritative marker is the server's
# ~/suas-data/.deploy-commit.
#
# Verified:
#  - no hybrid: the server and origin/main resolve to the same rev
#  - live site / returns 200, with the gallery, the hero slides and the calendar
#    intact, and every gallery thumbnail the page names answering 200
#  - a submission goes to the strip, not the gallery: photo_accept() on the server
#    moved a queued photo into photos/submissions/ with its thumbnail, created no
#    hero slide, and left nothing in photos/ -- so it renders in the strip and
#    cannot reach the slideshow. The tile markup names the credit the submitter
#    gave, and the file it points at exists
#  - photos/submissions/ is served (a photo in it answers 200, the directory
#    answers 403 from Options -Indexes rather than the 404 that photos/queue/
#    gets), so the queue rule did not catch the new directory
#  - sending back returns a photo from either public collection to the private
#    queue with its thumbnail, and strips a hero slide only where one existed
#  - the delete log distinguishes the three: queued -> "Rejected from the review
#    page", accepted -> "Deleted from the photos sent in", curated -> "Deleted
#    from the gallery admin page"
#  - the review page lists all three collections, and the titlebar carries the
#    Admin link on / and on /about.php
#  - nothing private is served: /includes/*, /suas-config.php, /photos.json and
#    /photos/queue* answer 404; README.md, deploy.sh and server-state.txt are 403
#  - security headers present: HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options,
#    Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
#
# Fixed during this deploy, having only shown up here:
#  - photo_rename_thumb() now creates the destination's thumbs/ directory. rename()
#    into a directory that does not exist fails silently, so accepting the first
#    photo a site receives moved the photograph and stranded the thumbnail: the
#    strip rendered a tile pointing at a missing file. The local test had passed
#    only because its fixture had pre-created the directory.
#
# State, not a fault of the deploy:
#  - the strip is empty. Nothing has been accepted since the change landed
#  - photos 30, 31 and 32 (Vansh Srivastava, Vansh Srivastava, Jonathon Zhong)
#    were accepted through the review page BEFORE this change, when accepting
#    still meant moving into photos/, so they are in the curated gallery and the
#    hero slideshow. Under the rule now in force they belong in the strip. Moving
#    them is one photo_accept() each from the queue, or a file move, and is a
#    content decision rather than a code one
#  - mail.log records the earlier notification as "sent", which means the host's
#    MTA took it. Whether it reaches an inbox rather than a spam folder is not
#    something this file can attest to; SPF and DMARC exist for usydastro.org
#  - the From address is photos@usydastro.org, which is not a mailbox or a
#    forwarder on this account. It is on the sending domain, which is what SPF
#    needs, and replies go to the submitter via Reply-To. Set notify_from in
#    ~/suas-config.php if that should change
